model_io.model: REDA: adaptive search weight cycling + stochastic recombination + elite memory
inputs: black-box optimization problems (29 CEC2017 + 19 constrained engineering)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adaptive cyclic search weight balances exploration-exploitation better than fixed strategies
hypotheses.result: REDA significantly outperforms 13 state-of-the-art algorithms; especially strong in low-dimensional spaces

nature:10.1038/s42005-026-02592-w.key_results: General distance measure for weighted hypergraphs reduces to classic graph distance; applied to arXiv preprint network with cognitive distance weighting
nature:10.1038/s42005-026-02592-w.comments: Theoretical contribution addressing a genuine gap; cognitive distance weighting is well-motivated; real-world applicability demonstrated but limited.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hypergraph distance measure avoids information loss from clique projection
hypotheses.result: Full hypergraph measure necessary for real-world datasets; clique projection loses significant structural information

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-70948-5.task: Enable damage-free transfer of soft electronics onto curved and fragile biological surfaces
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-70948-5.key_results: Yield-stress fluid at 0.0253 kPa (orders below tissue rupture ~0.2 kPa); demonstrated thermal sensing on moving joints without device or tissue damage
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-70948-5.comments: Innovative fluid mechanics solution with elegant biological application; biocompatibility and long-term stability remain to be established.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ultra-low yield stress and adhesion-switching enable non-invasive transfer without deformation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; successful thermal sensing on moving joints with preserved device and tissue integrity

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-45779-5.task: Demonstrate poling-induced second-order optical nonlinearity in amorphous sodium niobate waveguides
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-45779-5.key_results: Sustained second-order nonlinearity after waveguide processing (UV lithography, dry-etch); precise spatial control of SONL via micrometer-scale poling
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-45779-5.comments: Attractive alternative to lithium niobate with isotropic design advantages, but efficiency and scalability for practical devices require further optimization.

model_io.model: Amorphous sodium niobate thin-film waveguides with thermal poling

hypotheses.hypothesis: Thermal poling induces persistent SONL in amorphous Na-niobate, retained through fabrication
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; strong SHG signals persist after UV lithography and dry-etching

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-45929-9.task: Characterize electron temperature and density in RF-DBD Ar/CH₄ plasma across operational parameter ranges
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-45929-9.key_results: Electron temperature 0.98–1.08 eV (Ar, 0.5–1.0 Torr), ~1.2 eV (Ar/CH₄) at 4 W; electron density 10¹⁴–10¹⁵ m⁻³; Hα intensity correlates with hydrogen species; deposited carbon films amorphous structure
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-45929-9.comments: Systematic parametric characterization useful for plasma process control; connection to hydrogen production efficiency and carbon material quality could be strengthened.

model_io.model: RF-DBD Ar/CH₄ plasma with optical diagnostics

hypotheses.hypothesis: Plasma operational parameters systematically control electron temperature, density, and gas conversion efficiency
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; pressure, power, and flow rate relationships quantified for controlled H₂ production

hf:2603.25728.key_results: Superior disentanglement of expression semantics; robust identity preservation with continuous, controllable expression editing and smooth blending
hf:2603.25728.comments: The FFE dataset and benchmark are valuable contributions, though the practical applications beyond portrait editing are unclear.

outputs: edited facial images with target expressions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Symmetric joint training with contrastive learning produces more distinguishable expressions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieved precise and stable linear expression control

hf:2603.25040.key_results: 1-trillion-parameter model; mastery of 100+ specialized tasks across chemistry, materials, life sciences, earth sciences; outperforms proprietary models in specialized depth
hf:2603.25040.comments: Scale is impressive but claims of outperforming proprietary models lack quantitative evidence in the abstract.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Trillion-scale multimodal models can achieve both general and specialized expertise
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; demonstrated across general benchmarks and 100+ scientific tasks

hf:2603.25502.task: Real-world image restoration with large-scale editing models
hf:2603.25502.key_results: State-of-the-art open-source performance matching closed-source alternatives; covers 9 degradation types; achieves first-rank on RealIR-Bench
hf:2603.25502.comments: The reliance on large-scale pre-trained models may limit generalizability to truly novel degradation types unseen during training.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Large-scale image editing models generalize better to real-world degradations than task-specific restoration models
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple degradation types

hf:2603.24800.key_results: ~100 parameter modifications improve DiT performance; reduces inference steps required; maintains high-quality outputs
hf:2603.24800.comments: The evolutionary algorithm approach for optimization is computationally expensive despite claiming efficiency; generalization across different DiT architectures is not fully explored.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Introducing learned scaling parameters in DiT blocks significantly improves generative quality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; consistent improvements across text-to-image models with minimal parameters

hf:2603.25319.task: Multi-reference image generation with structured long-context data
hf:2603.25319.key_results: 400K-sample MacroData dataset with up to 10 references; MacroBench with 4K samples; substantial improvements in multi-reference generation
hf:2603.25319.comments: The structured dataset organization across 4 dimensions is thoughtful, but scalability to handling even more references (15+) remains unaddressed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Structured long-context data with cross-task co-training improves multi-reference generation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; demonstrated synergistic benefits of cross-task training

hf:2603.25551.task: Expressive multilingual text-to-speech with voice cloning
hf:2603.25551.key_results: 68.4% win rate over ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 in human evaluation; generates natural speech from 3 seconds of reference audio
hf:2603.25551.comments: The hybrid VQ-FSQ quantization scheme is technically sound, but the 3-second minimum reference requirement may be impractical for very brief voice samples.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid architecture combining semantic tokens (AR) and acoustic tokens (flow-matching) enables expressive multilingual TTS
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; preferred for naturalness and expressivity in human evaluation

hf:2603.24755.task: Benchmarking code quality degradation in iterative agentic tasks
hf:2603.24755.key_results: No agent solves any problem end-to-end; highest checkpoint solve rate 17.2%; agent code 2.2x more verbose than human; erosion rises in 80% of trajectories
hf:2603.24755.comments: This benchmark exposes a critical gap in current agentic reasoning—code maintenance and refactoring are severely underperforming, indicating fundamental architectural limitations.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Current coding agents degrade code quality over iterative extensions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; verbosity increases in 89.8% of trajectories; erosion worsens across iterations

hf:2603.23516.task: Efficient long-context memory for LLMs at 100M token scale
hf:2603.23516.key_results: Scales to 100M tokens with <9% degradation from 16K; linear complexity in training/inference; 100M-token inference on 2xA800 GPUs
hf:2603.23516.comments: MSA's approach is sound, but the comparison with RAG systems may not be entirely fair given different architectural paradigms; real-world applicability to domain-specific tasks unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sparse attention with document-wise RoPE and KV cache compression enables stable 100M-token scaling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves <9% degradation at 100M tokens

hf:2603.24793.task: Efficient audio-visual control for joint generation models
hf:2603.24793.key_results: State-of-the-art on depth/pose-guided generation; each modality trains in hundreds to thousands of steps; supports diverse modalities with no architectural changes
hf:2603.24793.comments: The parallel canvas design is elegant, but the framework's scalability to even more control modalities (>7) and cross-modal interference remains unexplored.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Parallel canvas approach resolves structural control failures in extended video generation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; outperforms baselines on depth, pose, and camera control

hf:2603.25745.key_results: High-fidelity 4K novel view synthesis without per-scene optimization; decouples geometric complexity from resolution; uses fewer Gaussian primitives
hf:2603.25745.comments: The texture prediction approach is practical, but the paper lacks comparison with recent NeRF variants and multi-resolution rendering baselines.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Per-primitive textures decouple resolution scaling from primitive count
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; enables 4K synthesis without quadratic primitive growth

hf:2603.25744.task: Multi-resolution fusion for Vision Foundation Models
hf:2603.25744.key_results: Universal, training-free enhancement working across multiple VFM families (DINOv2, SigLIP2); improves performance on diverse vision tasks
hf:2603.25744.comments: While the approach is elegantly simple, the computational cost of multi-resolution processing is only briefly mentioned; efficiency gains/losses unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-resolution inference fuses complementary global and fine-grained inductive biases
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; improves performance across diverse vision tasks in multiple VFM families

hf:2603.14366.task: Representation alignment for pixel-space Diffusion Transformers
hf:2603.14366.key_results: FID improved from 3.66 to 3.17 for JiT-B/16; IS improved from 275.1 to 284.6; >2x faster convergence; FID=1.81 for JiT-H/16
hf:2603.14366.comments: PixelREPA addresses a real failure mode of REPA for pixel-space diffusion, but the proposed masking strategy seems empirically-driven without theoretical justification.

model_io.model: PixelREPA (alignment target transformation + Masked Transformer Adapter)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Information asymmetry between high-dim image space and compressed semantic target causes REPA failure in JiT
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; PixelREPA mitigates through masked transformer adaptation

hf:2603.25702.task: Fast decoding for block-diffusion language models
hf:2603.25702.key_results: Up to 4.7x speedup over autoregressive decoding on SDAR; 1.57x speedup over tuned baseline with +4.5 accuracy points
hf:2603.25702.comments: The self-speculative approach is clever, but overhead of routing policies and verification steps may dominate in latency-critical scenarios.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Same pretrained model can act as both drafter (block-diffusion) and verifier (autoregressive) for efficient decoding
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves consistent speedup with improved accuracy across families

hf:2603.24943.task: Benchmarking LLM agents for financial tool use
hf:2603.24943.key_results: 613 samples across 10 scenarios; 65 real financial MCPs; evaluates single-tool, multi-tool, and multi-turn complexity
hf:2603.24943.comments: The benchmark is comprehensive but lacks qualitative error analysis; unclear which failure modes dominate in financial reasoning tasks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLMs can effectively invoke financial tools for real-world problem solving
hypotheses.result: Partially tested; FinMCP-Bench establishes standardized evaluation

hf:2603.23883.key_results: 1.3M audio clips, 2.3M images covering 14,133 species; unified representation captures species-level semantics beyond taxonomy
hf:2603.23883.comments: The integration of audio is novel for biodiversity tasks, but ecological trait prediction from audio alone may be inherently noisy without companion visual context.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Audio modality provides complementary information for species identification beyond vision and text
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; unified representation captures cross-modal species semantics

hf:2603.25562.task: Improving on-policy distillation for long-horizon LLM training
hf:2603.25562.key_results: Addresses imbalanced signals, unreliable teacher guidance, and tokenizer mismatches; more stable optimization and better downstream performance
hf:2603.25562.comments: The theoretical analysis of variance-bias tradeoffs is insightful, but empirical improvements are incremental; scalability to very long horizons (100+ steps) unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Token-level OPD suffers from information asymmetry; truncated reverse-KL with top-p sampling mitigates this
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; improves stability and downstream performance in math and agentic tasks

hf:2603.25398.task: Efficient image and video segmentation with frozen Vision Foundation Models
hf:2603.25398.key_results: Matches frozen-encoder SOTA on images; ~3x faster; matches fully finetuned performance on video; 8x faster than frozen-encoder baselines
hf:2603.25398.comments: PMT successfully decouples decoder design from encoder training, enabling practical VFM deployment; trade-off between speed and accuracy is well-balanced.

model_io.model: PMT (Plain Mask Decoder on frozen VFM encoders)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Transformer-based decoder can match finetuned performance while keeping encoder frozen for multi-task sharing
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves parity with finetuned methods on video while maintaining encoder frozen

hf:2603.18718.task: Coordinating memory construction and retrieval in LLM agents
hf:2603.18718.key_results: Consistent improvements over baselines across LLM backbones; works as plug-and-play enhancement for multiple storage backends
hf:2603.18718.comments: MemMA's multi-agent framework is well-motivated, but the in-situ self-evolution mechanism introduces additional computational overhead during inference.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Coordinating forward (construction/retrieval) and backward (repair) memory paths improves agent performance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; outperforms baselines across multiple LLM backbones and storage backends

hf:2603.13904.task: Pixel-level scene understanding for robotic decision-making
hf:2603.13904.key_results: State-of-the-art on vision-based robot policy learning; preserves pixel-level scene composition; encodes what-moves-where dynamics
hf:2603.13904.comments: CroBo's global-to-local reconstruction is effective, but applicability to high-dimensional state spaces (100+ objects) is unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Global-to-local reconstruction objective produces visual states encoding semantic identity and spatial configuration
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves SOTA on robot policy benchmarks; encodes what-moves-where

hf:2603.25741.task: Language-instructed autonomous driving with world models
hf:2603.25741.key_results: 100K-scene InstructScene dataset; superior planning performance; strong instruction-following abilities
hf:2603.25741.comments: Vega combines vision, language, and world models well, but generalization to out-of-distribution instructions and edge cases remains unvalidated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Unified vision-language-world-action model enables instruction-following autonomous driving
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; demonstrates superior planning and instruction-following abilities

hf:2603.25718.task: Electrostatic tuning of photoluminescence in perovskite transistors
hf:2603.25718.key_results: 65-98% modulation of photoluminescence; nearly complete elimination of non-radiative losses possible; high external quantum efficiencies in large-area devices
hf:2603.25718.comments: This materials science work demonstrates impressive optoelectronic control, but practical device stability and long-term performance under continuous operation are not addressed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Gate electric field modulates interfacial charge density, controlling radiative vs. non-radiative recombination
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves 65-98% photoluminescence modulation via electrostatic tuning

hf:2603.21768.task: Precipitation nowcasting with spectral fusion of radar and weather model priors
hf:2603.21768.key_results: State-of-the-art performance on SEVIR and MeteoNet; extends reliable forecast horizon; maintains structural fidelity
hf:2603.21768.comments: PW-FouCast's frequency-domain fusion is mathematically elegant, but the dependence on external weather foundation model predictions introduces potential error propagation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pangu-Weather spectral priors aligned via frequency modulation improve long-horizon nowcasting
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; extends reliable forecast horizon while maintaining structural fidelity

hf:2603.16733.task: Code intelligence with multi-stage training and reasoning
hf:2603.16733.key_results: SOTA performance on agentic software engineering, competitive programming, tool use; recurrent mechanism enables efficient deployment
hf:2603.16733.comments: The code-flow multi-stage training paradigm is comprehensive, but the 'thinking path' utilizing reasoning RL details are vague; comparison with GPT-4 code performance unclear.

model_io.model: IQuest-Coder-V1 (code LLM with reasoning-RL and instruction paths)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Code-flow multi-stage training captures dynamic software logic evolution
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves SOTA on agentic, competitive, and tool-use benchmarks

hf:2603.14636.task: Training-free model steering for audio-language reasoning
hf:2603.14636.key_results: Up to 4.4% accuracy improvement over CoT prompting; cross-modal transfer from text to speech effective; high data efficiency
hf:2603.14636.comments: Model steering is a clever inference-time technique, but the cross-modal transfer result is surprising and deserves deeper investigation into why text steering generalizes to speech.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Steering vectors derived from text can guide speech-based reasoning in LALMs
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves cross-modal transfer with high data efficiency

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71044-4.task: Elucidate mechanism of metal insertion by AAA+ ATPase NorQ-NorD complex
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71044-4.key_results: Cryo-EM structures reveal two key interfaces between NorQ hexamer and NorD VWA domain; NorQ exerts twisting and stretching force on NorD linker enabling metal insertion into nitric oxide reductase
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71044-4.comments: Elegant structural insight into force generation by AAA+ ATPases, though in vivo validation of metal insertion dynamics would strengthen mechanistic claims.

hypotheses.hypothesis: NorQ hexamer applies mechanical force to NorD linker via two distinct interfaces
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by cryo-EM structures and biochemical analyses showing finger-like VWA extension penetrates central pore and C-terminal contacts post-sensor 1 loop

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71061-3.task: Determine mechanism by which NAC detects mitochondrial targeting sequences and prevents SRP mistargeting
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71061-3.key_results: NAC barrel domain adopts stabilized conformation upon MTS exposure; MTS mutations or NAC switch mutations increase barrel dynamics and reduce ribosomal binding; impaired NAC function causes ER stress in human cells
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71061-3.comments: Identifies a novel conformational switch mechanism for protein targeting discrimination, though the structural details of the stabilized barrel state remain to be resolved.

inputs: NAC with functional or mutant switch

hypotheses.hypothesis: NAC switch region enables MTS-dependent barrel stabilization on ribosomes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; switch mutations increase dynamics and reduce ribosomal binding capacity

hypotheses.hypothesis: NAC-mediated prevention of SRP access maintains protein targeting fidelity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; impaired NAC function increases mistargeting and triggers ER stress

nature:10.1038/s41567-026-03189-4.task: Demonstrate hydrodynamic torque dipole generation by bacterial flagella and force transmission to external objects
nature:10.1038/s41567-026-03189-4.key_results: Confined swimming E. coli generate persistent rotation of symmetric discs via torque dipole-mediated traction force; mechanism is contactless and orientation-independent
nature:10.1038/s41567-026-03189-4.comments: Novel contactless force transmission mechanism with implications for bacterial transport in confined environments, though the scaling to physiologically relevant pore sizes and biofilm contexts requires further study.

model_io.model: Swimming E. coli with rotary flagella in confined geometry

hypotheses.hypothesis: Torque dipole of confined swimming bacteria can power external disc rotation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; persistent disc rotation observed in confined geometries

hypotheses.hypothesis: Torque dipole force generation is contactless and independent of bacterial orientation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; additive mechanism observed regardless of bacterial orientation

nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08540-4.task: Examine 14-3-3γ role in osteoblast differentiation and bone mineralization
nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08540-4.key_results: 14-3-3γ knockdown promotes matrix mineralization in human mesenchymal stromal cells
nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08540-4.comments: The abstract is incomplete; full mechanistic details, quantitative results, and downstream target confirmation are needed for comprehensive assessment.

hypotheses.hypothesis: 14-3-3γ suppression enhances osteogenic differentiation
hypotheses.result: supported by mineralization phenotype

nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08584-6.task: Review huntingtin pre- and postsynaptic roles in cortico-striatal synapse integrity
nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08584-6.key_results: HTT regulates synaptic vesicle cycle at presynaptic terminals and modulates receptor dynamics at postsynaptic density; expanding network of HTT-interacting proteins essential for synaptic structure
nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08584-6.comments: This is a comprehensive review synthesizing 30 years of research; the reliance on cell and tissue culture models may not fully capture in vivo disease complexity in HD.

nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08629-w.task: Elucidate LKB1-mediated NK cell survival via redox and iron homeostasis
nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08629-w.key_results: Lkb1 ablation impairs autophagy and mitochondrial function, causing ROS-dependent cell death; iron overload exacerbates cytotoxic lipid ROS; ROS/iron inhibition rescues survival; Lkb1 deficiency increases PD-1/TIGIT expression
nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08629-w.comments: The coupling of metabolic, oxidative, and iron homeostasis checkpoints is novel, though the AMPK-independent mechanisms remain partially undefined.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lkb1 maintains NK cell survival through metabolic checkpoint regulation independent of AMPK
hypotheses.result: confirmed; AMPK activation or mTORC1 inhibition does not rescue defects

hypotheses.hypothesis: ROS and iron homeostasis coordinately regulate NK cell quiescence
hypotheses.result: confirmed; targeted interventions on ROS or iron rescue survival defects

nature:10.1038/s41420-026-03028-8.task: Delineate FOXO3/NRIP1-mediated TFAM regulation in NSCLC radioresistance
nature:10.1038/s41420-026-03028-8.key_results: TFAM knockdown restores radiosensitivity; FOXO3 directly binds TFAM promoter and NRIP1 acts as coactivator; FOXO3 knockdown suppresses A549-RR tumor growth and improves radiotherapy response in vivo
nature:10.1038/s41420-026-03028-8.comments: The FOXO3–NRIP1 coactivator complex is well-characterized, but tissue-specific or context-dependent nuances in this axis may limit generalizability to other NSCLC subtypes.

hypotheses.hypothesis: FOXO3 transcriptionally activates TFAM to confer radioresistance
hypotheses.result: confirmed via ChIP-qPCR and functional knockdown

hypotheses.hypothesis: NRIP1 enhances FOXO3-dependent TFAM regulation as a coactivator
hypotheses.result: confirmed; NRIP1 co-immunoprecipitates with FOXO3 and regulates TFAM without affecting FOXO3 levels

nature:10.1038/s41420-026-03062-6.task: Review gut-brain axis contributions to cerebral cavernous malformation pathogenesis
nature:10.1038/s41420-026-03062-6.key_results: Dysbiosis triggers systemic inflammation via LPS-TLR4, SCFAs, and TMAO pathways, affecting cerebrovascular function and blood-brain barrier integrity; gut microbiota may influence endothelial cell proliferation, migration, and apoptosis
nature:10.1038/s41420-026-03062-6.comments: This is a conceptual review proposing gut-brain axis mechanisms in CCM; the evidence linking dysbiosis to specific CCM phenotypes remains largely correlative and requires experimental validation.

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-43119-1.task: Evaluate berberine-nanoparticle hepatoprotection via oxidative balance and autophagy-apoptosis crosstalk
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-43119-1.key_results: BRB-BSA NPs reduce serum uric acid (0.20±0.07 vs 1.35±0.1 mg/dL in DEN/CCl₄), restore SOD activity, normalize autophagic signaling via PI3K/mTOR/p62/LC3 downregulation/upregulation, and promote apoptosis (elevated Bax, reduced Bcl-2) with near-complete hepatic recovery
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-43119-1.comments: The post-injury treatment superiority over prophylaxis is noteworthy, and the multi-pathway restoration is comprehensive, though in vivo translational efficacy and long-term safety require further assessment.

hypotheses.hypothesis: BRB-BSA NPs restore oxidative-autophagic-apoptotic homeostasis in DEN/CCl₄ injury
hypotheses.result: confirmed; post-injury treatment more effective than prophylaxis

hypotheses.hypothesis: PI3K inhibition underlies BRB-mediated autophagy normalization
hypotheses.result: supported by molecular docking and pathway analysis

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-45230-9.task: Investigate chromatin dynamics of Klf4 locus in relation to transcriptional activity
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-45230-9.key_results: ANCHOR3 tracking reveals homogeneous chromatin motion of cis-regulatory elements and non-regulatory regions in both transcribing mESCs and non-transcribing EpiLCs
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-45230-9.comments: The finding challenges the transcription-driven locus dynamics model, suggesting that other mechanisms or larger-scale chromatin organization may dominate over local transcriptional activity.

inputs: ANCHOR3 DNA labeling at multiple Klf4 locus positions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Active transcription drives differential chromatin dynamics across regulatory regions
hypotheses.result: not supported; homogeneous motion observed in both transcribing and non-transcribing cells

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-45537-7.task: Identify miRNA biomarkers of replicative senescence in dental pulp stem cells
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-45537-7.key_results: Senescence induction increased miR-433-5p, miR-331-5p, miR-221-5p, miR-328-5p and decreased miR-205-5p, miR-455-5p, miR-21-5p; combined miRNA panels significantly improved discrimination of senescence states
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-45537-7.comments: The proof-of-concept for miRNA panels is solid, but forensic applicability requires validation across broader donor cohorts and post-mortem conditions.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Individual miRNAs serve as predictive biomarkers of senescence
hypotheses.result: partially supported; individual miRNAs show moderate predictive ability

hypotheses.hypothesis: miRNA panels improve senescence discrimination
hypotheses.result: confirmed; multivariable models combining miRNAs greatly enhance predictive power

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-45597-9.task: Inhibit erythroleukemia proliferation via dual GLUT1 and PI3K/AKT targeting
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-45597-9.key_results: FKL-137 significantly inhibits cell proliferation and induces apoptosis in vitro; prevents Friend virus-induced erythroleukemia and splenomegaly in mice
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-45597-9.comments: Dual targeting of glucose metabolism and signaling is therapeutically promising but whether GLUT1 inhibition is the primary driver versus PI3K/AKT remains unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: GLUT1 inhibition coupled with PI3K/AKT suppression drives anti-tumor effects
hypotheses.result: confirmed via mechanistic studies showing reduced glucose metabolism and altered signaling

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-45676-x.task: Dissect multi-omics mechanisms of SB-SD herbal formula against pancreatic cancer
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-45676-x.key_results: SB-SD inhibits PC cell proliferation, promotes apoptosis, and induces S/G2 arrest via HSP90AA1/MAPK3; suppresses PANC-1 xenograft growth; multi-omics reveal microbiota-metabolite-protein network involving Bacteroides caccae, Lactobacillus, choline metabolism, and BCKDK/GATM
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-45676-x.comments: The integration of multi-omics with gut microbiota is comprehensive, but causality between microbiota changes and tumor suppression remains correlative rather than mechanistically proven.

hypotheses.hypothesis: SB-SD suppresses PC through HSP90AA1/MAPK3 pathway modulation
hypotheses.result: confirmed via Western blotting in cell and xenograft models

hypotheses.hypothesis: Gut microbiota and metabolite shifts contribute to antitumor effects
hypotheses.result: supported by metagenomic and metabolomic profiling; mechanistic link requires validation

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-46028-5.task: Investigate estrogen-induced DNA replication defects and genomic instability in BRCA1-mutant cells
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-46028-5.key_results: Estrogen and estrogen metabolites inhibit replication fork progression and trigger DNA breaks, deletions, and LOH in BRCA1mut/+ cells; atrazine herbicide similarly induces instability; indole-3-carbinol (I3C) prevents estrogen-induced DNA damage
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-46028-5.comments: The identification of dietary compound I3C as a protective agent is promising but requires clinical validation; the mechanism by which estrogen metabolites specifically target BRCA1-deficient cells needs deeper mechanistic investigation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Estrogen and metabolites are genotoxic for ER-negative BRCA1-mutant cells
hypotheses.result: confirmed; estrogen triggers DNA breaks and cancer-initiating mutations

hypotheses.hypothesis: I3C prevents estrogen-induced DNA damage in BRCA1-mutant cells
hypotheses.result: confirmed; I3C mitigates replication stress and genomic instability

nature:10.1038/s42003-026-09924-0.task: Characterize PACS1R203W-induced dynein dysfunction via HDAC6 and BICD2
nature:10.1038/s42003-026-09924-0.key_results: PACS1R203W induces dynein loss-of-function via HDAC6-BICD2 complex formation; reduces dynein initiation frequency and velocity; defects rescued by HDAC6 inhibition or Lis1 expression; impairs furin trafficking and Golgi organization
nature:10.1038/s42003-026-09924-0.comments: The identification of PACS1–HDAC6–BICD2 as a pathogenic complex provides a mechanistic link between PACS1 syndrome and microtubule trafficking disorders, though broader implications for similar neurodevelopmental syndromes remain to be explored.

model_io.model: PACS1R203W cells + HDAC6 inhibitor or Lis1
outputs: restored dynein initiation frequency and velocity

hypotheses.hypothesis: PACS1R203W–HDAC6–BICD2 complex disrupts dynein function
hypotheses.result: confirmed; cargo motility assays show reduced initiation frequency and velocity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dynein dysfunction underlies Golgi fragmentation in PACS1 syndrome
hypotheses.result: supported; HDAC6 inhibition and Lis1 expression rescue dynein and Golgi phenotypes

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-46195-5.task: Suppress localization in ultrathin SrIrO3 films via SrTiO3 capping engineering

nature:10.1038/s41586-026-10357-2.task: Map evolution of superconducting phase diagram in twisted bilayer WSe₂ across twist angles 3.65°–5.0°
nature:10.1038/s41586-026-10357-2.key_results: Superconducting state evolves smoothly with twist angle; proximal to Fermi surface reconstruction with likely antiferromagnetic ordering; not tied to Van Hove singularity or half-band insulator; connects previously distinct 3.65° and 5° phase diagrams
nature:10.1038/s41586-026-10357-2.comments: The smooth phase diagram evolution and good device-to-device repeatability establish moiré WSe₂ as a premier platform for studying correlation strength effects on superconductivity.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Superconductivity smoothly evolves with twist angle

nature:10.1038/s41586-026-10446-2.task: Resolve atomic-scale structural evolution of strained La₃Ni₂O₇ thin films using picometer-resolution electron microscopy
nature:10.1038/s41586-026-10446-2.key_results: Lifting of crystalline symmetry via Ni-O octahedral distortion under compressive strain identified as key for superconductivity; in-plane lattice compression is common attribute between bulk and thin-film superconductivity; octahedral symmetry raises t₂g orbital mixing energy
nature:10.1038/s41586-026-10446-2.comments: Multislice electron ptychography provides unprecedented atomic resolution to disentangle coupled structural distortions in corner-sharing octahedra, directly informing theoretical framework.

hypotheses.result: Confirmed via MEP structural analysis and theory showing symmetry lifting

hypotheses.result: Supported by DFT predictions linking structure to electronic gaps

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-41613-0.task: Explore overdoping effects in transient liquid assisted grown YBCO superconducting films via oxygenation strategies
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-41613-0.key_results: Three oxygenation methods (oxygen-ozone, Ag surface decoration) systematically analyzed; oxygen content and superconducting properties tuned via temperature, dwell time, ozone concentration; comparison with PLD-grown films provided
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-41613-0.comments: The unprecedented analysis of ozone-assisted oxygenation and comparison of three distinct methods provide practical insights for REBa₂Cu₃O₇₋δ fabrication optimization.

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-44651-w.task: Compare pressure-based and density-based solvers for underexpanded supersonic jet flow via Schlieren validation
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-44651-w.key_results: Both solvers predict Mach disk and shock cell structure to 4.5% accuracy; PR=1.92–5 covered; first shock at X/De≈1.09, 1.57, 2 for PR=3,4,5; DB solver overpredicts turbulent kinetic energy far-field; PB solver reliable at reduced cost; discharge coefficients agree to <0.2%
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-44651-w.comments: The demonstration that pressure-based solvers, traditionally associated with incompressible flows, reliably model supersonic jets opens cost-effective pathways for high-speed CFD.

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-46132-6.task: Solve obstacle-aware inverse kinematics of variable-length continuum robots via teaching-learning-based optimization
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-46132-6.key_results: TLBO achieves best tracking accuracy (mean 7.84×10⁻⁵ mm, best 4.95×10⁻⁷ mm) with no parameter tuning; outperforms PSO/GA/DE over 30 runs; experimental validation on CBHA platform shows good cable-length agreement; capsule-based obstacle avoidance effective
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-46132-6.comments: The parameter-free nature of TLBO combined with superior performance and experimental validation on a real continuum robot platform demonstrates practical utility.

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-46239-w.task: Identify non-Fermi liquid ground state in Holstein model discontinuous metal-NFL-insulator transition away from half-filling
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-46239-w.key_results: NFL phase emerges as distinct ground state of finite extent, not consequence of quantum criticality; spin gap opens without charge gap; two-fluid strange metallicity from metal-NFL phase boundary mixture
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-46239-w.comments: The identification of NFL without quantum criticality offers a fresh perspective on understanding strange metallicity in correlated materials.

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-46693-6.task: Engineer miniaturized Helmholtz resonators with mode hybridization for subwavelength sound attenuation
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-46693-6.key_results: Compliance-driven modal hybridization couples acoustic and mechanical modes; achieves λ/38 subwavelength attenuation; complex frequency analysis reveals pole-zero motion governed by compliance and viscoelastic loss balance; light-based 3D printing enables multi-material implementation
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-46693-6.comments: The unification of traditional Helmholtz resonator theory with soft metamaterial compliance through complex pole analysis provides elegant mechanistic insight.

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47126-0.task: Measure ultrafast plasma dynamics in laser-irradiated nanowire arrays using X-ray free-electron laser
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47126-0.key_results: Electron temperature ~120 eV at main-pulse peak, rising to ~140 eV at ~10 ps during wire collapse; restricted electron transport suppresses heated-area enlargement; XFEL enables spatiotemporally resolved measurement
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47126-0.comments: The ~20 eV temperature rise tied to wire collapse is a direct signature of complex plasma-structure coupling in nanowire arrays.

nature:10.1038/s41699-026-00691-4.task: Investigate magnetic properties and skyrmion hosting potential in 2D ferromagnetic FeXZ₂ compounds
nature:10.1038/s41699-026-00691-4.key_results: Easy-axis tilts up to 41°; Monte Carlo simulations yield Curie temperatures below room temperature; micromagnetic simulations predict zero-field Néel-type skyrmions in Janus FeNbSeTe
nature:10.1038/s41699-026-00691-4.comments: Second-nearest magnetic interactions play a decisive role despite smaller magnitude, which is somewhat counterintuitive but well-established through hopping parameter analysis.

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-70341-2.task: Map genetic architecture of allosteric hormone receptor dose-response function
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-70341-2.key_results: ~40,000 measurements showing 90% of missense variants tune dose-response; protein stability identified as latent mechanism; modular architecture enables independent tuning of signaling parameters

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-44611-4.task: Optimize chemo-immunotherapy scheduling in TNBC by modeling tumor-immune dynamics
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-44611-4.key_results: Treatment timing synchronized with NK cell oscillations promotes tumor elimination; longer MTX-free intervals reduce recurrence; immune-boosting before chemotherapy broadens therapeutic window

hf:2603.24414.task: Security protection for OpenClaw autonomous agents
hf:2603.24414.key_results: Three-layer protection framework (skills, plugins, watchers) effectively prevents data leakage, privilege escalation, and malicious skill execution across diverse threat scenarios
hf:2603.24414.comments: Addresses critical gap in agent security by introducing decoupled watcher-based middleware paradigm that could generalize beyond OpenClaw.

hf:2603.28407.task: Benchmarking multimodal deep research agents on process and outcome
hf:2603.28407.key_results: Process quality predicts outcome better than output-level metrics alone; multimodal tasks cause 3-10 point performance drop; MiroThinker-H1 achieves highest balanced performance
hf:2603.28407.comments: Novel process-centric evaluation dimension is valuable, though benchmark limited to 100 tasks and may need more diversity in real-world complexity.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Process quality correlates with outcome quality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; process serves as reliable performance predictor

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multimodal tasks are harder than text-only
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 3-10 point performance degradation observed

hf:2604.00073.task: Enterprise task automation via terminal agents
hf:2604.00073.key_results: Simple terminal agents with API access match or outperform complex tool-augmented and web agent architectures on diverse real-world systems
hf:2604.00073.comments: Practical finding that challenges industry assumptions about necessary complexity; validates direct programmatic interfaces over graphical abstraction layers.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Complex agentic architectures (MCP, web agents) are necessary for enterprise automation
hypotheses.result: Rejected; simple terminal agents suffice and often outperform

hf:2603.25823.task: Evaluating visual generative models on reasoning-centric tasks
hf:2603.25823.key_results: State-of-the-art systems harbor significant reasoning deficits; cross-modal evaluation reveals logical failures despite visual fidelity in AIGC models
hf:2603.25823.comments: Well-motivated critique that existing metrics miss logical reasoning gaps; dual-track evaluation of processes and results is methodologically sound.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Modern AIGC models possess robust physical and causal reasoning capabilities
hypotheses.result: Rejected; significant reasoning deficits exposed across state-of-the-art systems

hf:2603.26648.key_results: 193 tasks across 16 categories; substantial performance gaps at all levels; state-of-the-art models achieve ~60% on static UI-to-code but struggle on full-stack development
hf:2603.26648.comments: Comprehensive hierarchical structure (static→interactive→full-stack) well-designed; GUI+VLM verification paradigm is practical and extensible.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Visual LLMs can effectively handle end-to-end website development
hypotheses.result: Partially rejected; full-stack development remains substantially harder than static UI generation

hf:2603.26017.key_results: Context-length crossover: deep learning leads at short context (L=96), foundation models at long context (L≥576); forecastability drives 3.64× MAE variation; scaling data beats scaling model size
hf:2603.26017.comments: Regime-balanced approach (TSF properties vs. domain labels) is methodologically superior; cross-benchmark consistency strengthens findings.

hypotheses.result: Rejected; crossover at intermediate context; DL competitive at 59× fewer parameters

hypotheses.hypothesis: Scaling model parameters improves forecasting more than data
hypotheses.result: Rejected; data scaling provides substantially greater benefit

hf:2604.01161.task: Understanding reasoning robustness under context variation
hf:2604.01161.key_results: Reasoning traces shorten up to 50% under different context conditions; compression correlates with reduced self-verification; performance impact on hard tasks unexplored
hf:2604.01161.comments: Important robustness concern for reasoning models; finding suggests potential failure modes in production settings with variable context.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reasoning models produce consistent trace lengths regardless of context
hypotheses.result: Rejected; up to 50% compression observed under different context conditions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Context-induced compression preserves performance on all tasks
hypotheses.result: Partially supported; performance unaffected on straightforward problems but unclear on hard tasks

hf:2604.01221.task: Evaluating agents on multimodal personal file management
hf:2604.01221.key_results: 48.3% accuracy on user profiling; multimodal perception and evidence grounding are primary bottlenecks; 42.4GB real-world file system benchmark with 2K+ files
hf:2604.01221.comments: User-centric realistic setting is valuable; the 46.1K annotated trajectories enable fine-grained failure diagnosis unavailable in other benchmarks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Advanced MLLMs excel at cross-modal reasoning in dense personal file systems
hypotheses.result: Rejected; significant performance gap with major bottlenecks identified

hf:2603.26653.key_results: 1,114 questions require multiple temporally separated visual evidence; human accuracy drops to 18.97% without rewatching; best MLLM (Gemini-3-Flash) reaches 45.96%
hf:2603.26653.comments: Challenging benchmark design requiring compositional logic across temporal gaps; open-source models substantially worse (below 40%) suggests frontier model advantage.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Perception-centric long-horizon reasoning is a solved problem
hypotheses.result: Rejected; major performance gap and evidence that it remains a bottleneck

hf:2604.01220.task: Efficient depth scaling via recursive computation architecture
hf:2604.01220.key_results: Universal YOCO maintains constant global KV cache with linear pre-filling; favorable capability-efficiency tradeoff vs. standard YOCO or recursion alone; competitive on general and long-context benchmarks
hf:2604.01220.comments: Clever architectural combination (YOCO decoder + recursion) addresses real inference bottleneck; practical for long-context and test-time scaling applications.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Parameter sharing via recursion can enhance representational depth without proportional overhead
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; partial recursion improves scaling with limited efficiency cost

hf:2603.26661.key_results: Fully autoregressive transformer-based approach enables step-by-step 3D scene construction; supports completion, outpainting, temperature-controlled sampling; compatible with neural rendering pipelines
hf:2603.26661.comments: Novel autoregressive formulation contrasts with dominant diffusion paradigm; compositional inductive biases of autoregressive modeling are well-motivated for 3D generation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Diffusion is necessary for high-quality 3D scene generation
hypotheses.result: Rejected; autoregressive alternative viable with complementary advantages

hf:2604.01193.key_results: Simple self-distillation (SSD) improves Qwen3-30B from 42.4% to 55.3% pass@1; gains concentrate on harder problems; generalizes across Qwen/Llama at 4B-30B scale
hf:2604.01193.comments: Elegant method requiring only temperature/truncation tuning and SFT; attributing gains to precision-exploration trade-off is insightful and well-supported.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLMs cannot improve at code generation without external feedback or teacher models
hypotheses.result: Rejected; simple self-distillation on raw outputs suffices

hypotheses.hypothesis: SSD gains stem from suppressing distractor tails while preserving exploration diversity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed through token distribution analysis

hf:2604.01128.task: Evaluating presentation quality and hallucinations in AI-written papers
hf:2604.01128.key_results: Clear trade-off between presentation and hallucination: ClaudeCode higher quality but 10+ hallucinations/paper; Codex fewer hallucinations but lower presentation; 51 papers from 2025+ venues
hf:2604.01128.comments: First systematic framework for AI paper writing evaluation; orthogonal dimensions (Presentation/Hallucination) are well-motivated but hallucination detection may miss subtle errors.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Model advances uniformly improve AI-written paper quality
hypotheses.result: Rejected; trade-off between presentation and hallucination accuracy observed

hf:2604.00842.task: Evaluating proactive agents in stateful digital environments
hf:2604.00842.key_results: 143 diverse tasks spanning communication, productivity, scheduling; tests context observation, goal inference, intervention timing, multi-app orchestration; enables active user simulation via FSM modeling
hf:2604.00842.comments: FSM-based application modeling improves on flat API abstractions; 143 tasks seem moderate in scale but diverse scope is valuable for comprehensive evaluation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Flat tool APIs adequately model digital environment interactions
hypotheses.result: Rejected; FSM with stateful navigation required for realistic simulation

hf:2604.00528.task: Zero-shot 3D visual grounding via 2D VLM agent framework
hf:2604.00528.key_results: Think-Act-Build framework outperforms supervised baselines; decouples 2D VLM semantics from 3D geometry; Semantic-Anchored Geometric Expansion addresses multi-view coverage gaps
hf:2604.00528.comments: Clever 2D-to-3D paradigm avoids reliance on 3D point clouds; manual benchmark corrections improve reliability but generalization to uncurated data unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: 3D visual grounding requires preprocessed 3D point cloud processing
hypotheses.result: Rejected; 2D-to-3D reconstruction via VLM agent suffices and surpasses supervised approaches

hf:2604.00626.task: Comprehensive survey of on-policy distillation for LLMs
hf:2604.00626.key_results: Unified f-divergence framework over on-policy samples; three orthogonal dimensions (feedback signal, teacher access, loss granularity); identifies scaling laws and agent-level distillation as open problems
hf:2604.00626.comments: Survey provides valuable conceptual unification across fragmented OPD literature; identifies exposure bias as core motivation but mechanistic understanding of student learning dynamics remains limited.

hypotheses.hypothesis: On-policy distillation addresses exposure bias in LLM training

hf:2604.00590.task: Unified scaling architecture for recommendation systems
hf:2604.00590.key_results: UniMixer bridges attention-based, TokenMixer, and factorization-machine methods; UniMixing-Lite compresses parameters/FLOPs while improving performance; online experiments validate scaling benefits
hf:2604.00590.comments: Unifying theoretical framework is valuable; removal of head-count constraint over TokenMizer is practical but scalability limits vs. foundation models unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Attention, TokenMixer, and factorization methods are fundamentally incompatible
hypotheses.result: Rejected; unified parameterized framework subsumes all three

hf:2603.25406.task: Diffusion-based vision-language-action model for robot control
hf:2603.25406.key_results: 98.0% average success on LIBERO; 4.78 average length on CALVIN; unified multi-modal discrete diffusion enables parallel goal and action generation without auxiliary world models
hf:2603.25406.comments: Native diffusion VLA avoids hierarchical/autoregressive overhead; parallel generation is elegant but comparison with simpler alternatives (e.g., autoregressive baselines) would strengthen claims.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Discrete diffusion with masked denoising improves long-horizon robot control consistency
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via state-of-the-art performance on simulation and real tasks

hf:2604.01029.key_results: Three additive components (re-solving, scaffold, content) explain gains; on MCQ stronger-model direct routing often beats revision; on code tasks weak drafts provide structural scaffolding despite semantic issues
hf:2604.01029.comments: Controlled decomposition experiment design is rigorous; findings challenge blanket revision assumptions but task-dependent nature may limit generalization.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-LLM revision gains uniformly stem from error correction
hypotheses.result: Rejected; gains decompose into re-solving, scaffold, and content contributions varying by task

hf:2604.00913.task: Evaluating VLMs on assembly instruction alignment across visual modalities
hf:2604.00913.key_results: 1,623 questions across 6 task types; architecture family predicts alignment accuracy better than parameter count; diagrams and video occupy disjoint ViT subspaces; text shifts models toward text-driven reasoning
hf:2604.00913.comments: IKEA-Bench construction from real products is practical; mechanistic analysis revealing disjoint subspaces is insightful but sample size (29 products) may limit generalization.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Parameter scale determines cross-depiction alignment robustness
hypotheses.result: Rejected; architecture family is stronger predictor than model size

hypotheses.hypothesis: Text assists diagram-to-video alignment
hypotheses.result: Rejected; text degrades alignment by shifting toward text-driven reasoning

hf:2603.29002.task: Accelerating memory processing in disaggregated LLM inference
hf:2603.29002.key_results: 22%-97% memory processing overhead identified; heterogeneous GPU-FPGA system achieves 1.04-2.2× speedup and 1.11-4.7× energy reduction vs. GPU baseline; unified four-step pipeline framework
hf:2603.29002.comments: Systematic profiling reveals heterogeneity opportunity; FPGA offloading of sparse/irregular operations is practical but adoption barriers (specialized hardware, deployment complexity) remain.

model_io.model: LLM Inference (sparse attention, RAG, compressed memory)

hypotheses.hypothesis: GPU monolithic processing is optimal for memory-bounded operations

hf:2603.29247.task: Preference memory extraction for personalized product reranking
hf:2603.29247.key_results: MemRerank distills purchase history into concise query-independent signals; +10.61 absolute points in 1-in-5 accuracy; RL-trained memory extractor outperforms baselines on downstream reranking
hf:2603.29247.comments: Practical framework for e-commerce personalization; RL supervision on reranking performance is well-motivated but evaluation limited to 1-in-5 selection task.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Raw purchase history effectively guides LLM-based product reranking

hf:2603.23582.task: Generalization of deep learning sleep staging to clinical populations
hf:2603.23582.key_results: Poor cross-domain performance between healthy and ischemic stroke cohorts; Grad-CAM reveals model focuses on physiologically uninformative regions in patient data; iSLEEPS dataset with ischemic stroke annotations

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-70904-3.task: Characterize Sam50 folding pathways and link folding dynamics to functional regulation in β-barrel assembly

nature:10.1038/s41567-026-03215-5.task: Demonstrate active self-assembly of elastic membranes via non-reciprocal coupling between actin fibres and microtubule-based active fluid

nature:10.1038/s41388-026-03755-3.task: Characterize m6A-epitranscriptomic axis regulating EMT and gastric cancer metastasis

nature:10.1038/s41418-026-01726-5.task: Identify ATM-PINK1-STUB1 signaling cascade regulating peroxisomal quality control via pexophagy

hypotheses.result: Confirmed; facial recognition study demonstrates practical feasibility
